name: MonarchSubscriptionsTable
title: SubscriptionsTable
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows (androidx.compose.foundation.clickable, MonarchText, MonarchStatusBadge, MonarchMoney, androidx.compose.material3.HorizontalDivider), MonarchEmptyState when empty
summary: A list of recurring agreements: name and plan, customer, status, price per billing period, the monthly figure and the next renewal, each amount in its own currency.
whenToUse: To show a customer's or a workspace's subscriptions, contracts or licenses, with their status and next renewal, on a phone or a tablet.
whenNotToUse: For upcoming renewals with owners and actions, use MonarchRenewalsPanel. For what unused items cost, use MonarchSavingsPanel. It does not sort, filter or add up; do that in the app.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSubscriptionsTable(subscriptions: List<MonarchSubscription>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = null, locale: Locale? = null, showCustomer: Boolean = true, showMonthly: Boolean? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchSubscription) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSubscriptionsTableLabels = MonarchSubscriptionsTableLabels())

class MonarchSubscription(id: String, name: String, status: String, amount: BigDecimal?, currencyCode: String, plan: String? = null, quantity: Int = 1, customer: String? = null, interval: MonarchSubscriptionInterval? = MonarchSubscriptionInterval.Month, intervalCount: Int = 1, monthly: MonarchSubscriptionMonthly? = null, renewalDateMillis: Long? = null, renewsAutomatically: Boolean = true, cancelsAtMillis: Long? = null, changesAtMillis: Long? = null)
enum class MonarchSubscriptionInterval { Day, Week, Month, Year }
sealed interface MonarchSubscriptionMonthly { class Amount(amount: BigDecimal, currencyCode: String); data object NotConverted }

class MonarchSubscriptionsTableLabels(caption: String? = null, subscription: String? = null, customer: String? = null, status: String? = null, price: String? = null, monthly: String? = null, renewal: String? = null, customPrice: String? = null, quantity: ((Int) -> String)? = null, interval: ((MonarchSubscriptionInterval?, Int) -> String)? = null, priceSuffix: ((String) -> String)? = null, spokenPrice: ((String, String) -> String)? = null, spokenOneTimePrice: ((String) -> String)? = null, cancels: ((String) -> String)? = null, changes: ((String) -> String)? = null, renews: ((String) -> String)? = null, ends: ((String) -> String)? = null, evergreen: String? = null, notConverted: String? = null, notConvertedHint: String? = null, noValue: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null)

options.name: subscriptions
options.description: The rows, in display order. Empty shows the empty state.

options.name: registry
options.description: More statuses, or replacements for the built-in draft, trial, active, past_due, paused, cancelled and expired.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts and dates. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: showCustomer
options.description: Shows the customer. Turn it off on a single customer's screen.

options.name: showMonthly
options.description: Shows the monthly figure; null shows it when any subscription has one.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Makes each row a button called with its subscription, for example to open it. Replaces the web href and renderLink.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the period words and the spoken price.

states.name: compact
states.description: Below 640dp each row has the name, the plan line and customer · renewal at the start, and the status badge, the price with its period and the monthly figure at the end.

states.name: wide
states.description: From 640dp the rows are a table with Subscription, Customer, Status, Price, Monthly and Renewal columns under muted headings.

states.name: selectable
states.description: With onSelect each row is a button at least 48dp tall with a focus ring.

states.name: not converted
states.description: A live (active or past due) subscription whose monthly figure could not be converted shows "Not converted"; TalkBack also reads the explanation.

states.name: evergreen
states.description: No renewal date shows "Evergreen"; a subscription that does not renew shows "Ends …".

states.name: empty
states.description: No subscriptions: a small MonarchEmptyState, "No subscriptions".

appearance: Rows on the surrounding surface separated by subtle dividers, names in the default text color and secondary lines in the muted color; each status badge carries its tone and its words. The same in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web SubscriptionsTable is an HTML table with container queries and links. On Android it is a Column of rows at compact width and a table with weighted columns from 640dp, rather than a LazyColumn, so it can sit inside the screen's verticalScroll with other content; this matches iOS. Links (href, renderLink) become onSelect, which the app uses for navigation. Amounts are BigDecimal in major units; minorUnits is not offered. Dates are epoch milliseconds (UTC) written with android.icu.text.DateFormat; there is no timeZone parameter. The relative-time dependency of the plan is not used: renewal dates are absolute, as on the web. The caption is the table's spoken name only (labels.caption), and the not-converted hint, a hover title on the web, is read by TalkBack. The default statuses are MonarchSubscriptionsTableDefaults.statuses(), with localised labels. iOS ships the same MonarchSubscriptionsTable.
accessibility: Each row is one TalkBack element read in words: name, plan line, customer, status, price "per month", monthly figure and renewal.
The table is a traversal group named "Subscriptions" with collection info; each row carries its row index.
With onSelect each row has the button role, a 48dp minimum height and a focus ring.
The column headings of the wide table and the empty-cell dashes are hidden from TalkBack.
Status is always written in words in its badge, not only by color.
Text wraps at font scale 2.0; right to left, the name and the price mirror.
edgeCases: Amounts are never converted or added; each stays in its own currency.
A quantity of 1 is not written; 3 is written "3 ×" before the plan.
A missing price or monthly figure is a dash read as "No value".
An unknown status key is shown in the neutral tone with a label made from the key ("on_hold" gives "On hold").

examples.title: Across customers
examples.template:
MonarchSubscriptionsTable(
    subscriptions = listOf(
        MonarchSubscription(
            id = "s1",
            name = {{subscriptions.0.name}},
            status = {{subscriptions.0.status}},
            amount = BigDecimal({{subscriptions.0.amount}}).movePointLeft(2),
            currencyCode = {{subscriptions.0.currency}},
            plan = {{subscriptions.0.plan}},
            quantity = {{subscriptions.0.quantity}},
            customer = {{subscriptions.0.customer}},
            interval = MonarchSubscriptionInterval.{{subscriptions.0.interval|pascal}},
            monthly = MonarchSubscriptionMonthly.Amount(BigDecimal({{subscriptions.0.monthly.amount}}).movePointLeft(2), {{subscriptions.0.monthly.currency}}),
            renewalDateMillis = {{subscriptions.0.renewalDate|millis}},
        ),
        MonarchSubscription(
            id = "s2",
            name = {{subscriptions.1.name}},
            status = {{subscriptions.1.status}},
            amount = BigDecimal({{subscriptions.1.amount}}).movePointLeft(2),
            currencyCode = {{subscriptions.1.currency}},
            plan = {{subscriptions.1.plan}},
            customer = {{subscriptions.1.customer}},
            interval = MonarchSubscriptionInterval.{{subscriptions.1.interval|pascal}},
            monthly = MonarchSubscriptionMonthly.NotConverted,
            renewalDateMillis = {{subscriptions.1.renewalDate|millis}},
            renewsAutomatically = {{subscriptions.1.autoRenew}},
        ),
        MonarchSubscription(
            id = "s3",
            name = {{subscriptions.2.name}},
            status = {{subscriptions.2.status}},
            amount = BigDecimal({{subscriptions.2.amount}}).movePointLeft(2),
            currencyCode = {{subscriptions.2.currency}},
            customer = {{subscriptions.2.customer}},
            interval = MonarchSubscriptionInterval.{{subscriptions.2.interval|pascal}},
            intervalCount = {{subscriptions.2.intervalCount}},
            monthly = MonarchSubscriptionMonthly.Amount(BigDecimal({{subscriptions.2.monthly.amount}}).movePointLeft(2), {{subscriptions.2.monthly.currency}}),
            cancelsAtMillis = {{subscriptions.2.cancelAt|millis}},
        ),
    ),
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    // The web table names the customer and the renewal under the plan, not in columns of their own.
    showMonthly = false,
    renewalUnderName = true,
)

examples.title: A product status added to the defaults
examples.code:
MonarchSubscriptionsTable(
    subscriptions = listOf(
        MonarchSubscription(id = "a", name = "Archive", status = "on_hold", amount = BigDecimal("9.00"), currencyCode = "USD"),
    ),
    registry = MonarchStatusRegistry(mapOf("on_hold" to MonarchStatusDefinition("On hold", MonarchTone.Warning))),
    showCustomer = false,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The panel writes its dates as plain calendar days in UTC, which is the fixture time zone, so no time zone value is passed; a date at midnight UTC never moves to the previous day.
parityExceptions.convention: day-granular dates are written in UTC, so no zone parameter is needed
